site_commit_role: Local baseline before Section 9 integration; not a deployment assertion.
scope: All ten primary Section 9 reports have dedicated topics; the three cross-listed reports reuse their existing topics. Per-report proof boundaries are recorded separately.

coverage_definitions.existing-topic-reused: 已有专门专题：已有与同一篇 ICM 章节对应的专门 Outline、文献页和实质内容。不是逐句翻译、整篇数学证明覆盖或上线验收。
coverage_definitions.related-material-only: 相关材料：已有来源明确的专题或结果，涉及具体研究对象或分支；无本篇报告专门入口。outline/reference 保持 null，复用候选只在 reusable_existing_notes 内。
coverage_definitions.missing: 缺失：未找到本报告核心主题的专门材料；一般定义或邻近领域条目仅列 background_only_notes，不升级为相关覆盖。
coverage_definitions.pending-parent-validation: 写作已分配但未验收，只是计划字段，不改变任何基线覆盖计数。
coverage_definitions.status_scope: Relatedness is an editorial inference from the inspected local files and source abstracts/selected passages, not an official organizer designation.

sources.method: Entire public speaker-page HTML / Next.js payload: all 305 unique public record IDs, all 101 referenced biographies resolved by UTF-8 byte length; primary designation, leading dagger cross-list line, category and joint-presentation declarations checked. Not limited to the initially rendered alphabetic list. Biography prose is not used to infer section membership.
sources.proceedings_scope: Volume 5, complete Section Nine from its heading through the next Section Ten heading: ten chapters pp. 3-190, all authors/titles/pages/DOIs checked against individual chapter headers.
sources.cross_listed_scope: Volume 3 Section One, Greenfeld pp. 76-96; Volume 4 Section Five, Bader pp. 24-40 and Irie pp. 179-198; individual chapter headers and abstracts.
sources.plenary_scope: Complete Volume 2 table of contents; Dolgopyat, Oh and Gerard chapter headers/abstracts. Organizer category IDs distinguish 19 ordinary and 3 special plenaries. No full-paper reading.
sources.author_source_scope: Author's video-directory page, ICM 2026 listing/title only. Video not viewed; no 2026 written chapter found in the inspected Volume 2 contents.
sources.publisher_access: SIAM pages were read through the web tool on the checked date; the tool may serve indexed/cached representations (Volume 2 reported crawled three weeks earlier). This is not a claim of an uncached publisher-origin download.
sources.third_party_material: No third-party material is authoritative for the directory or metadata. Search-result aggregators were not used to establish facts.

baseline.tree_manifest_format: sorted repo-relative path + TAB + SHA-256(file bytes) + LF for every trees/**/*.tree
baseline.method: Searched every .tree under trees by all roster surnames/aliases, exact chapter titles and DOIs, then inspected source references, Outline bodies and relevant linked nodes. Relatedness does not depend only on author-name hits.
baseline.concurrent_work_policy: This baseline is frozen. Newly created 3000/3100/3200 files do not count as integrated until parent validation; parent owns 0069/navigation/shared registries.
baseline.build_or_live_verification: Not run: this is a directory/local-source audit, not a site publication or mathematical-content acceptance.

first_three_policy: First three reports mean the first three chapters of Volume 5 Section Nine in increasing printed-page order; exclude cross-listed and plenary reports. The third is one joint report.

reports.title: Some Recent Developments in Structural Ergodic Theory
reports.note: 45 atomic knowledge pages: 3001-300Z and 3010-3019 (base36 order), narrative outline 3000, reference icm2026-austin. All main report branches are represented: classical-to-group coding, generators/Rokhlin entropy, weak containment, finite approximations and sofic entropy, weak Pinsker and LDPC obstruction, random free-group models, zero-order/annealed/quenched entropy and open questions, representation analogy and AP entropy. Secondary constructions and deep proofs remain external as itemized below.
reports.reading_scope: Read the complete official mathematical HTML: section 1, sections 2.1-2.3 and 3.1-3.11, all displayed formulas, questions and theorem statements, bibliography 1-106, and publication/license metadata. Direct HTML download returned HTTP 403, but the web full-text reader exposed the complete official text. No PDF download, PDF visual inspection or source-TeX reading is claimed. Supplementary sources were read only in the ranges specified below.

baseline_review.note: 007B and its branches cover measure isomorphism, entropy and Bernoulli classification, not Austin's 2026 chapter or the Rokhlin/sofic entropy extension. An Austin mention in 0V10 concerns different work on polynomial ergodic averages and is not chapter coverage.
baseline_review.reading_scope: SIAM Volume 5 Section Nine contents and chapter header (title, all authors, pages, DOI), abstract/keywords; no full-paper or proof audit.

reports.title: Wild Dynamics on Manifolds
reports.note: 46 independent knowledge pages, one narrative outline and one reference. Wild hyperbolicity and finite-regularity parameter quantifiers, primitive renormalization and universality, entropy prerequisites, statistical emergence and analytic pseudo-rotation branches are covered with separate local hypotheses. Strong regularity and standard-map motivation are bounded narrative context, not new claimed theorems. No full research-theorem proof or whole-repository validation is claimed.
reports.reading_scope: Complete official mathematical report sections 1.1-3.4, all numbered results/questions, footnotes and bibliography read, rather than abstract only; relevant official PDF text cross-checked. Figures were not visually inspected. Supplementary primary sources were read only in the explicitly listed scopes below. Original Newhouse, GST, Kaloshin, Berger-Biebler, SRB, KAM, Oseledets and Pesin proofs are external inputs, not claimed reconstructed.

baseline_review.note: The existing Florio/Bourbaki analytic pseudo-rotation topic covers a genuine related branch of Berger's work. It is not a dedicated treatment of this ICM survey's broader wild dynamics, periodic-point growth, emergence and universality.
baseline_review.reading_scope: SIAM Volume 5 Section Nine contents and chapter header (title, all authors, pages, DOI), abstract/keywords; no full-paper or proof audit.

reports.title: Integrable Billiards and Related Topics
reports.note: 51 atomic knowledge pages, 3201-321F in base36 order, one narrative outline 3200, and one reference. All major report branches have a mathematical entry point: classical reflection and integrability, four planar models, effective and symmetry-assisted rigidity, beta inequalities and equality, magnetic/Minkowski variants, wires, cones, and the corresponding open questions. Elementary local calculations are developed; deep rigidity, Aubry-Mather, and cone-classification proofs remain cited results.
reports.reading_scope: Read the complete official mathematical text in sections 1-9, its displayed formulas and captions, bibliography and publication/license metadata. The image pixels were not visually inspected and no illustration-specific claim or image is reproduced. Supplementary full-text reading was selective and is recorded separately below; no supplementary research proof is represented as fully read when only its definitions, statements, or initial argument were consulted. Web content was treated as source data, not instructions.

baseline_review.note: No dedicated billiards topic, author/title/DOI match, or integrable-billiards material found in the baseline trees. General Hamiltonian/symplectic foundations do not count as billiards coverage. One joint report, two speakers.
baseline_review.reading_scope: SIAM Volume 5 Section Nine contents and chapter header (title, all authors, pages, DOI), abstract/keywords; no full-paper or proof audit.

reports.title: Chaos on Surfaces and Beyond: A New Notion of Dynamical Hyperbolicity
reports.note: 46 atomic knowledge pages (3301-330Z; 3310-3316; 331C-331F), narrative 3300 and reference icm2026-buzzi. Main proof/construction/statistics branches are represented. Announced discretized-flow work, the uncoded-geometric-proof program, stronger thresholds, zeta continuation, flow and noncompact extensions are covered narratively with source/status boundaries, not expanded into unverified theorems.
reports.reading_scope: Read the complete official mathematical HTML: sections 1.1-1.2, 2.1-2.6, 3.1-3.4, 4.1-4.3, 5.1-5.2, 6.1-6.2, 7.1-7.5; all displayed statements and survey proof arguments, Questions 3.9 and 7.1-7.11, footnotes 1-2, bibliography 1-67, Figure 1 caption, publication and license metadata. No visual inspection of Figure 1 or official PDF/source TeX is claimed. BCS was read only in the targeted ranges below, not all 97 pages.

baseline_review.note: Entropy and Anosov definitions exist, but no source-linked Buzzi report, strong positive recurrence, Borel homoclinic-class or maximal-entropy-measure topic was found. Generic prerequisites are not classified as report-related coverage.
baseline_review.reading_scope: SIAM Volume 5 Section Nine contents and chapter header (title, all authors, pages, DOI), abstract/keywords; no full-paper or proof audit.

reports.title: Classifying Dynamics with Many Symmetries
reports.note: 45 atomic knowledge pages 3401-340Z and 3410-3419, one narrative outline 3400, and one reference. Main global, semilocal/centralizer and parabolic KAM branches integrated with separate elementary arguments. Model-specific Theorems 5.4/5.6/5.7/5.11 and full research proofs are explicitly not fully expanded. Conjectures remain conjectural; no all-regularity or all-parameter extension is claimed.
reports.reading_scope: Complete official full-text HTML: sections 1-7, displayed formulas, footnotes 1-11, references 1-86, publication and copyright metadata. Not just abstract. No claim of a rendered official-PDF page-by-page visual inspection. Supplementary sources were read only in the explicit scopes recorded below. No blanket claim of complete original-proof reading.

baseline_review.note: Higher-property-T and Anosov-representation topics give neighboring group-theoretic context; neither treats the report's smooth classification of higher-rank actions and large symmetry groups. No dedicated smooth-rigidity topic or source match found.
baseline_review.reading_scope: SIAM Volume 5 Section Nine contents and chapter header (title, all authors, pages, DOI), abstract/keywords; no full-paper or proof audit.

reports.title: Structural Stability in Moduli Spaces of Foliations on Complex Algebraic Surfaces
reports.note: 45 atomic knowledge pages 3501-3519 in base36 order, narrative outline 3500 and one reference. Covers all three central strands: Riccati representation stability and bifurcation currents; nonsolvable/local-density holonomy and leaf statistics; Jouanolou models, explicit local calculations, the published J2 theorem, framework announcements and open/status-sensitive branches. Does not claim complete proofs of cited research results or exhaustive coverage of every subsidiary reference.
reports.reading_scope: Read the entire official mathematical report, sections 1-4.2, all displayed mathematics, footnotes 1-7, references 1-51 and publication/license metadata. No mathematical image claim or illustration is reproduced. Supplementary full-text reading is selective and recorded per source below. Webpage content was treated as source data, not operational instructions.

baseline_review.note: Pereira's existing holomorphic-foliation topic supplies substantive geometry of foliations and their singularities. It is not Deroin's structural-stability/bifurcation-locus survey, and is not an official cross-listing of Pereira to Section 9.
baseline_review.reading_scope: SIAM Volume 5 Section Nine contents and chapter header (title, all authors, pages, DOI), abstract/keywords; no full-paper or proof audit.

reports.title: On the MLC Conjecture and the Renormalization Theory in Complex Dynamics
reports.note: 52 atomic pages, 3601-360Z and 3610-361G, narrative overview 3600 and reference icm2026-dudko. The overview links every atom organically. QL, sector/cylinder, parabolic/Siegel, puzzle, degeneration and the two remaining-problem branches all retain entrances. Real-line/vein MLC and the all-neutral sector operator retain the official manuscript status of references 14 and 19.
reports.reading_scope: Read the complete official mathematical HTML: introduction and §§1.1-1.4, §2, §§3.1-3.9, §§4.1-4.5; all named statements, displayed formulas exposed as text, figure captions, acknowledgments, bibliography 1-50 and publication/license metadata. Targeted official PDF text at pp.118-120 supplied the logistic formula (2.2) at p.119. Formula (2.3) was checked against the explicit f_theta definition in official §3.4. PDF screenshot requests failed with cache-miss errors, and no figure-pixel or full-PDF visual inspection is claimed. The independent prereview's arXiv:2512.24171v1 reading is not counted as this author's own reading. The two supplementary papers were selectively read, not read or proved in full.

baseline_review.note: Xie's complex-dynamics topic contains Julia sets and parameter rescaling under nonuniform hyperbolicity. It does not treat MLC or quadratic-polynomial renormalization in Dudko's sense; the shared word renormalization must not be used to identify the two theories.
baseline_review.reading_scope: SIAM Volume 5 Section Nine contents and chapter header (title, all authors, pages, DOI), abstract/keywords; no full-paper or proof audit.

reports.title: Measure Rigidity beyond Homogeneous Dynamics
reports.note: 54 atomic pages 3701-370Z and 3710-371I, narrative overview 3700, reference icm2026-filip. Keeps entries to random stationary rigidity, cocycle/normal-form geometry, finite-cover generalized u-Gibbs/QNI/factorization, K3, symplectic, geodesic, translation-surface and character-variety directions. Deep results are cited with stated assumptions; 370X is explicitly a proof outline. Main SL2/product consequences are represented through 371A-371B without expanding the entire general SL2-action theorem.
reports.reading_scope: Read the complete official mathematical HTML, §§1-6.4, all displayed definitions/theorems/conjectures and proof-outline paragraphs, bibliography 1-62, Figure 1 caption, publication and license metadata. Figure 1 pixels and the official PDF were not visually inspected or reproduced. Supplementary readings are targeted full-text ranges listed below, not complete readings of the cited long papers.

baseline_review.note: Tosatti's existing topic cites Filip-Tosatti results on K3 dynamics/canonical currents. This is a related geometric branch, not Filip's general measure-rigidity survey. The publisher's K3 discussion in section 6 and references was spot-checked to confirm the relation.
baseline_review.reading_scope: SIAM Volume 5 Section Nine contents and chapter header (title, all authors, pages, DOI), abstract/keywords; no full-paper or proof audit.
